GROUP BY d.department_id, d.department_name;

records.prompt: Show the highest paid employee in each department
records.reference_sql:
SELECT cd.dept_name, e.emp_name, e.salary 
FROM employees e 
JOIN corp_departments cd ON e.dept_id = cd.dept_id 
WHERE e.salary = (
    SELECT MAX(e2.salary) 
    FROM employees e2 
    WHERE e2.dept_id = e.dept_id
);

off.sql: SELECT cd.dept_name, e.emp_name, e.salary FROM employees e JOIN corp_departments cd ON e.dept_id = cd.dept_id WHERE e.salary = (SELECT MAX(e2.salary) FROM employees e2 WHERE e2.dept_id = e.dept_id);

on.sql:
WITH RankedEmployees AS (
    SELECT 
        e.emp_name,
        cd.dept_name,
        e.salary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.dept_id ORDER BY e.salary DESC) as rn
    FROM employees e
    JOIN corp_departments cd ON e.dept_id = cd.dept_id
)
SELECT emp_name, dept_name, salary
FROM RankedEmployees
WHERE rn = 1;
